name: Recital AD
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: AD. whereas, despite its claims of non-interference in the domestic affairs of other states, China has repeatedly violated other states’ sovereignty; whereas in recent years, numerous Confucius Institutes in Europe, America and Australia have been closed over concerns that Beijing is using them to spread propaganda, conduct espionage, divert key technologies, and curtail freedom of expression and academic freedom, including through their ambiguous legal status and financial leverage;
